hunks.baseline: The instant Jopil’s red-hot palm struck my chest, energy as hot as lava swept through me. My breath caught, and my internal energy surged backward.
hunks.sol: The instant Jopil’s red-hot palm struck my chest, lava-hot qi swept through me. My breath caught, and my internal energy surged backward.

hunks.baseline: The question came with me as I was sent flying. I slammed and rolled some ten zhang before I could stop.
hunks.sol: The question crossed my mind as I went flying. I bounced and rolled for more than ten zhang before finally coming to a stop.

hunks.baseline: Blood trickled down my chin. The unidentified chunks mixed in with it now and then were… fuck. Pieces of organ.
hunks.sol: Blood trickled down my chin. Every so often, unidentified chunks came up with it. They were… fuck. Pieces of my organs.

hunks.baseline: Through my blurry vision, Jopil walked toward me. His unhurried stride had a victor’s ease.
hunks.sol: Through my blurred vision, I saw Jopil walking toward me. His unhurried stride carried the ease of a victor.

hunks.baseline: I groped beside me and found a cool spear shaft. Using the spear as a cane, I barely made it to my feet—and saw Jopil’s scowling eyes.
hunks.sol: I groped beside me until my hand closed around a cool spear shaft. Using the spear as a cane, I barely managed to stand—and found Jopil staring at me with narrowed eyes.

hunks.baseline: “You can still stand after taking a Flame Divine Palm at seventy percent power… What a high-maintenance junior.”
hunks.sol: “You can still stand after taking a Flame Divine Palm at seventy percent power… What a troublesome junior.”

hunks.baseline: His palm detonated into me again.
hunks.sol: Another palm strike slammed into me.

hunks.baseline: The Flame Divine Palm was every bit as powerful as its name. My shirt burned away, and my flesh melted and sloughed off. The heat that sank inside me severed my blood channels strand by strand.
hunks.sol: The Flame Divine Palm was every bit as powerful as its name. My shirt burned away, and my flesh melted and sloughed off. The heat that invaded my body tore through my meridians one after another.

hunks.baseline: Horrible pain crashed in. Instead of writhing in it, I drove the spear at Jopil’s vital point.
hunks.sol: Horrific pain crashed over me. Instead of writhing in agony, I thrust my spear at Jopil’s vital point.

hunks.baseline: The next moment, I let go of the seized spear and threw myself into his chest.
hunks.sol: The next instant, I let go of the spear and threw myself into his chest.

hunks.baseline: Last chance. Focus every bit of internal energy on a single point. If I struck his vital point, I could turn the tide.
hunks.sol: This was my last chance. I focused every bit of internal energy into a single point. If I could strike one of his vital points, I could turn the tables.

hunks.baseline: I had forced my internal energy up without accounting for my internal injuries. I collapsed on the spot and shook like I’d been struck by lightning.
hunks.sol: I had forced up my internal energy without regard for my internal injuries. I collapsed on the spot, trembling as if I’d been struck by lightning.

hunks.baseline: I could feel drool running from the corner of my mouth.
hunks.sol: Drool ran from the corner of my mouth.

hunks.baseline: “Pfft. Puhahaha! Have you ever seen such a stupid bastard!”
hunks.sol: “Pfft. Puhahaha! What kind of idiot does that?”

hunks.baseline: Jopil burst into mad laughter and snapped the spearhead.
hunks.sol: Jopil howled with laughter and snapped off the spearhead.

hunks.baseline: I had no weapon left. Despair blacked out my vision.
hunks.sol: Now I didn’t even have a weapon. Despair darkened my vision.

hunks.baseline: In the last seven years, I had never felt death this close. Me—who had fought more than a thousand times and lived. Die here, of all places?
hunks.sol: In the past seven years, death had never felt this close. I had fought more than a thousand times and survived. Was I really going to die here, of all places?

hunks.baseline: This pointlessly?
hunks.sol: Just like that?

hunks.baseline: A shout crackling with static was the last thing I heard before all the light went out.
hunks.sol: A shout crackling with static was the last thing I heard before all light vanished.

hunks.baseline: When I opened my eyes again, it was neither heaven nor hell. I was drenched in sweat and panting. My whole body felt heavy, like waterlogged cotton.
hunks.sol: When I opened my eyes again, I was in neither heaven nor hell. I was drenched in sweat and panting, my whole body as heavy as waterlogged cotton.

hunks.baseline: Either way, one thing was certain. This was the past—a memory from seven years ago. The familiar face of the training instructor was proof enough.
hunks.sol: Whatever it was, one thing was certain. This was the past—a memory from seven years ago. The familiar face of the training instructor was proof enough.

hunks.baseline: “You—you, this…”
hunks.sol: “You… What did you…”

hunks.baseline: The instructor couldn’t finish. His eyes were on a steel dummy built for training. Modeled after a monster, it was little more than scrap metal now.
hunks.sol: The instructor couldn’t finish. He was staring at a steel training dummy modeled after a monster.

hunks.baseline: Bent and split scrap, head to toe.
hunks.sol: Now it looked more like scrap metal, bent and split all over.

hunks.baseline: “You don’t really know how to use it, but after Awakening you just started using it naturally?”
hunks.sol: “You don’t know how you’re doing it, but you started using it naturally after you Awakened?”

hunks.baseline: Looking incredulous, the instructor turned to the file in his hand.
hunks.sol: Looking dumbfounded, the instructor turned to the file in his hand.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. So? My full-power thrust—no, my skill. It’s good, right?”
hunks.sol: “Yes. So, my full-power thrust—no, my skill. It’s good, right?”

hunks.baseline: “I’ve been at this training center for fifteen years, and I’ve never seen anything like this. Destructive power like that should be at least D-rank.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve been at this training center for fifteen years, and I’ve never seen anything like it. That kind of destructive power shouldn’t appear below D-rank.”

hunks.baseline: “Fuck, I knew it. Uh, Instructor. I’m leaving.”
hunks.sol: “Fuck, I knew it. Instructor, I’m leaving.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m going to get reevaluated. Honestly, with power like that, I should at least be E-rank.”
hunks.sol: “I’m going to get reassessed. Honestly, that should be enough for E-rank, at least.”

hunks.baseline: “No. They seem to have judged you correctly over there.”
hunks.sol: “No. I think they assessed you correctly.”

hunks.baseline: “The skill really is incredible. It’s a level that could never come out of an F-rank. But…”
hunks.sol: “The skill itself is incredible. It’s far beyond anything an F-rank should be capable of. But…”

hunks.baseline: Before I could even nod, the instructor’s hand shot out like lightning and tapped my chest.
hunks.sol: Before I could even nod, the instructor’s hand shot out like lightning and tapped me on the chest.

hunks.baseline: Literally a tap. But I’d used up all my strength, so I flopped onto my back.
hunks.sol: Literally just a tap. But I’d used up all my strength, so I toppled flat onto my back.

hunks.baseline: My whole body throbbed. I could barely twitch a finger.
hunks.sol: My whole body throbbed. I could barely move a finger.

hunks.baseline: “You’re already putting out more power than your limits can handle. Later on, it won’t end with a little soreness.”
hunks.sol: “You’re already putting out more power than your body can handle. Eventually, it won’t end with a little soreness.”

hunks.baseline: “Solid fundamentals and excellent technique. And your own combat sense. If you want to live a long time, don’t use that skill. Ah. Except in special circumstances.”
hunks.sol: “Solid fundamentals. Excellent technique. And your own combat sense. If you want to live a long life, don’t use that skill. Ah, except under special circumstances.”

hunks.baseline: The instructor grinned and added,
hunks.sol: The instructor grinned.

hunks.baseline: The next moment, I opened my eyes on the cold snowfield.
hunks.sol: The next instant, I opened my eyes on the cold snowfield.

hunks.baseline: The shout I’d heard at the end came through clearly. So did my wrecked body, and the sharp pain.
hunks.sol: The last shout I’d heard now rang clear. So did the sharp pain from my mangled body.

hunks.baseline: The flash of my life had lasted only an instant. Jopil was looking behind him, close enough to reach if I stretched out a hand.
hunks.sol: My life had flashed before my eyes in a mere instant. Jopil had turned to look behind him, close enough for me to touch if I reached out.

hunks.baseline: “Not bad loyalty. Their skill’s pathetic, though.”
hunks.sol: “They’re certainly loyal. Their skills are pathetic, though.”

hunks.baseline: The reconnaissance squad was charging toward us in a cluster, right where he was looking.
hunks.sol: The reconnaissance squad was charging toward us in a cluster.

hunks.baseline: “I’m thinking of tearing those guys apart and killing them. What do you say?”
hunks.sol: “I’m thinking of tearing them apart. What do you say?”

hunks.baseline: “…dly. Fought.”
hunks.sol: “…been fighting…”

hunks.baseline: “Stupid… fought.”
hunks.sol: “Like an idiot… fighting…”

hunks.baseline: I mumbled it again. Jopil bent down, irritated.
hunks.sol: I mumbled again. Jopil bent down, irritation on his face.

hunks.baseline: “Can’t you even talk straight?”
hunks.sol: “Can’t you even speak properly?”

hunks.baseline: “I said I’ve been fighting stupidly this whole time.”
hunks.sol: “I said I’ve been fighting like an idiot this whole time.”

hunks.baseline: I spat the blood I’d gathered at his face. Half a beat faster, my hand was already slamming down toward his foot.
hunks.sol: I spat the blood I’d gathered into his face. At the same time, my hand—already moving half a beat ahead—slammed down toward his foot.
Jopil didn’t know.

hunks.baseline: Jopil didn’t know. I was a Hunter, a man of Murim, and a player who could use the System!
hunks.sol: I was a Hunter, a man of Murim, and a player who could use the System!

hunks.baseline: A solid weight filled my empty grip. Jopil, his face covered in blood, tried to jerk back, but the dagger’s tip had already punched through the top of his foot.
hunks.sol: A solid weight filled my empty hand. His face covered in blood, Jopil tried to jerk back, but the dagger had already punched through the top of his foot.

hunks.baseline: When his body jerked to a halt from the sudden pain, I dropped the dagger and reached for his ankle.
hunks.sol: His body froze at the sudden pain. I released the dagger and reached for his ankle.

hunks.baseline: My Inventory was piled with weapons from enemies I’d taken down since the Tutorial. Swords, spears, axes, daggers… more than twenty of them.
hunks.sol: My Inventory was piled with weapons taken from the enemies I’d killed since the Tutorial. Swords, spears, axes, daggers… more than twenty in all.

hunks.baseline: Jopil’s men had been a walking armory.
hunks.sol: Jopil’s men had been walking armories.
His Achilles tendon.

hunks.baseline: The Achilles tendon. The moment I cut the tendon at his ankle, a scream burst out of him. As his stance collapsed, I rolled aside, slashing and stabbing. His remaining left leg was soaked in blood too.
hunks.sol: The instant I severed the tendon at his ankle, a scream burst from him. As his stance collapsed, I rolled aside, slashing and stabbing until his remaining left leg was soaked in blood as well.

hunks.baseline: Jopil’s mouth fell open with rage and pain.
hunks.sol: Jopil’s mouth opened wide in rage and pain.

hunks.baseline: He couldn’t use either leg, but Jopil was a Peak master. He spun like lightning, slipped the dagger, caught my wrist, and twisted.
hunks.sol: Both his legs were useless, but Jopil was still a Peak master. He spun like lightning, slipped past my dagger, caught my wrist, and twisted.

hunks.baseline: The attack didn’t end there.
hunks.sol: His attack didn’t end there.

hunks.baseline: My chest caved in. My vision went white. Powerful fire qi tore through my body.
hunks.sol: My chest caved in. My vision went white as powerful fire qi tore through my body.

hunks.baseline: The strength drained out of me.
hunks.sol: The strength drained from me.

hunks.baseline: From the neck in Jopil’s grip came the sound of bone slipping out of place. A chilling voice slid into my ear.
hunks.sol: I heard the bones in my neck grind out of place under Jopil’s grip. His chilling voice slid into my ear.

hunks.baseline: “You understand now, don’t you. Who you picked a fight with.”
hunks.sol: “Now you understand, don’t you? Who you dared lay a hand on.”

hunks.baseline: To me, hanging limp as a corpse, Jopil declared it with a face full of rapture.
hunks.sol: As I hung limp as a corpse, Jopil declared with rapture written across his face,

hunks.baseline: The final Flame Divine Palm shot toward my chest. Lava that would swallow my life whole was imbued in that blazing palm.
hunks.sol: His final Flame Divine Palm shot toward my chest. Lava-hot power capable of swallowing my life whole burned within that crimson palm.
There was no lava. No heat of any kind.

hunks.baseline: No lava. No heat of any kind. Only a scarred, callused palm resting against my chest.
hunks.sol: Only his battered, callused palm resting against my chest.

hunks.baseline: A ripple ran through Jopil’s eyes.
hunks.sol: Jopil’s eyes trembled.

hunks.baseline: The grip on my throat slipped away. As Jopil staggered backward, I saw the dagger driven in below his navel—buried in his dantian.
hunks.sol: The grip around my throat went slack. As Jopil staggered backward, I saw the dagger below his navel, buried deep in his dantian.

hunks.baseline: “This… what the hell is this?”
hunks.sol: “What… What the hell is this?”

hunks.baseline: The next moment, blood ran down Jopil’s chin.
hunks.sol: The next instant, blood ran down his chin.

hunks.baseline: Blood started pouring from his eyes, his nose, and his ears as well. A waterfall of blood streamed from his seven orifices.
hunks.sol: Blood began pouring from his eyes, nose, and ears as well—a waterfall streaming from all seven orifices.

hunks.baseline: The reconnaissance squad stopped in their tracks at the horrifying sight. Someone muttered, almost a groan.
hunks.sol: The reconnaissance squad stopped in their tracks at the horrifying sight. Someone muttered as if groaning.

hunks.baseline: The result was a reversal of internal energy. Qi deviation.
hunks.sol: The result was a violent reversal of internal energy.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.sol: Qi deviation.

hunks.baseline: “You were definitely empty-handed.”
hunks.sol: “But you were empty-handed.”

hunks.baseline: I answered in a tired voice.
hunks.sol: I answered wearily.

hunks.baseline: “You live long enough, all sorts of things happen.”
hunks.sol: “Live long enough, and all sorts of things happen.”

hunks.baseline: Jopil muttered like a man whose soul had left him and took one step after another.
hunks.sol: Jopil muttered like a man who had lost his mind, stumbling forward one step at a time.

hunks.baseline: Wherever he passed, pools of blood collected.
hunks.sol: Pools of blood formed wherever he passed.

hunks.baseline: “I am Jopil. Jopil, One Question, One Kill. The nineteenth-generation successor of the Fire Gate Clan. I’m not someone who should die at the hands of a nobody like you!”
hunks.sol: “I am Jopil. Jopil, One Question, One Kill. The nineteenth-generation successor of the Fire Gate Clan. I am not someone who should die at the hands of a nobody like you!”

hunks.baseline: A chilling, ghostly aura came off him as he screamed, covered in blood. Even the reconnaissance squad members who had charged in ready to die were shaking with fear.
hunks.sol: A chilling, ghostly aura radiated from him as he screamed, drenched in blood. Even the reconnaissance squad members who had charged in ready to die trembled in fear.

hunks.baseline: “Then why? Why, at the likes of you, would I—!”
hunks.sol: “Then why? Why am I dying to the likes of you?!”

hunks.baseline: The change started in Jopil’s body. The flowing blood stopped, and the veins all over him stood out blue. He looked like a man who couldn’t feel the pain of both tendons being cut—or even the qi deviation.
hunks.sol: The change began in Jopil’s body. His bleeding stopped, and blue veins bulged all over him. He looked as if he could no longer feel the pain of his severed tendons—or even the qi deviation.

hunks.baseline: A terrible heat poured from his breath.
hunks.sol: Terrible heat poured from every breath.

hunks.baseline: No. This was Jopil’s last desperate struggle.
hunks.sol: No. This was Jopil’s final struggle.

hunks.baseline: Everyone screamed, seized by terror, but I could see it clearly. His hair was turning white by the second. His skin was shriveling.
hunks.sol: Everyone around me screamed in terror, but I could see it clearly. His hair was turning white by the second. His skin was shriveling.

hunks.baseline: Right now, that man was…
hunks.sol: Right now, he was…

hunks.baseline: *Burning his life.*
hunks.sol: *Burning away his life.*

hunks.baseline: *He’ll kill me, at least, before he goes.*
hunks.sol: *He means to kill me, at least, before he goes.*

hunks.baseline: Power gained by throwing away the most precious thing he had. Every bit of it was aimed at me. I knew on instinct that I couldn’t dodge.
hunks.sol: This was power gained by sacrificing the most precious thing he had, and every bit of it was aimed at me. I knew instinctively that I couldn’t dodge.

hunks.baseline: *Can I do this? Me?*
hunks.sol: *Can I do this?*

hunks.baseline: The *Sharp Spear* I’d used from the Tutorial until now.
hunks.sol: The *Sharp Spear* I’d used ever since the Tutorial.

hunks.baseline: Its spearhead was broken. Nothing left but a pointed iron rod.
hunks.sol: Its spearhead had been broken off. Now it was nothing more than a pointed iron rod.

hunks.baseline: Even if I succeeded, I couldn’t guarantee I’d live. But there was no luxury of hesitation.
hunks.sol: Even if it worked, there was no guarantee I’d survive. But I had no time to hesitate.

hunks.baseline: The noise around me receded. My heartbeat and breathing sounded like thunder.
hunks.sol: The noise around me receded. My heartbeat and breathing thundered in my ears.

hunks.baseline: My heartbeat hit its peak. My breathing locked in, precise as a machine.
hunks.sol: My heartbeat reached its peak. My breathing fell into place with mechanical precision.

hunks.baseline: I was certain.
hunks.sol: I knew.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, I woke the internal energy in my dantian. Inside me, where my qi and blood channels were twisted and wrecked, the only thing left was the third internal energy, hardened like rock.
hunks.sol: At that instant, I awakened the internal energy in my dantian. Inside my body, where my qi and blood pathways lay twisted and ruined, only one source of internal energy remained.
The third, hardened like rock.

hunks.baseline: My only option—and the last piece that would fill my Skill.
hunks.sol: My only option—and the final piece I needed to fuel my Skill.

hunks.baseline: The awakened energy went berserk. It forced its way through my ruined qi and blood channels and spread through my whole body. A dizzying pain hit me.
hunks.sol: The awakened energy went berserk. It forced its way through my ruined pathways and surged throughout my body. Mind-numbing pain struck me.

hunks.baseline: But it was soon forgotten in the new strength the energy gave me.
hunks.sol: But the new strength flooding through me soon made me forget it.

hunks.baseline: Every muscle in my body pulled taut. From my calves and thighs, through my waist and along my thrusting arm, every bit of strength and internal energy in me surged forward.
hunks.sol: Every muscle in my body pulled taut. From my calves and thighs, through my waist and along my thrusting arm, every last bit of my strength and internal energy surged forward.

hunks.baseline: Matching it, Jopil thrust out his Flame Divine Palm.
hunks.sol: At the same moment, Jopil thrust out his Flame Divine Palm.

hunks.baseline: A mound of snow erupted with the wind. Through the flakes drifting gently back down, Jopil came into view.
hunks.sol: Wind and snow erupted around us. Through the flakes drifting gently back down, Jopil came into view.

hunks.baseline: From the right arm that had unleashed the Flame Divine Palm, through his shoulder and his side—half of his upper body had evaporated.
hunks.sol: His right arm, the one that had unleashed the Flame Divine Palm, was gone. So were his shoulder and side.
Half his upper body had evaporated.

hunks.baseline: The next moment, heaven and earth flipped.
hunks.sol: The next instant, heaven and earth flipped.

hunks.baseline: Beyond my blurring vision, Jopil’s already lifeless head shot high into the sky.
hunks.sol: Beyond my blurring vision, Jopil’s lifeless head shot high into the sky.

hunks.baseline: Socheon was crying out loud, holding a sword as tall as he was.
hunks.sol: Socheon stood there sobbing, holding a sword as tall as he was.
